card.name: Start of G-words in medical terms
card.fires_on: The lone letter G (or the piece 'an' in guanfacine) that begins a medical term split into parts, such as Gynecomastia, Gait, Gland, Gastrointestinal. Also the X in Xanthine.

modes.label: G starting a term
modes.description: A bare G that opens a medical word like Gland, Gait, Gynecomastia or Gastrointestinal, often after a heading number or a bullet.
modes.example: 5.11 Fundic<< G>>land Polyps PPI use is associated

modes.label: Inside guanfacine
modes.description: The 'an' piece partway through the drug name guanfacine in interaction lists.
modes.example: Bosentan Gu<<an>>facine Monitor for adverse reactions.

card.writes: It seems to push toward Chinese word pieces and away from code terms, which suggests no useful output effect for English text.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letter of a split-up medical word starting with G, like Gland or Gait, in warnings sections.
